Some optimizations for Text
Ignore invalid authorization parameters. #2955
Configurations relying on that behavior may require changes.
Added rich.live https://github.com/willmcgugan/rich/pull/382
Decompression-bomb safeguards of the streaming API were bypassed:

Here, we have a `kw_only=True` *attrs* class (`Base`) with an attribute that sets `kw_only=False` and has a default (`Base.b`), and then create a subclass (`Subclass`) with required arguments (`Subclass.c`).
Fixed deprecation warning when using cryptography v39.0.0. This fix requires using pyOpenSSL>=17.1.0 and cryptography>=1.9. (https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/pull/2829)
section: Read the v2.0 migration guide for help upgrading to the latest version of urllib3.

text: Note: as a major version bump, this version has some breaking changes.
Better TLS cert format with `adhoc` dev certs. #2891
This should not break any of your code, because project-local packages have priority before installed ones.
The major version bump is to honor the passing of 3.8 support which reached its EOL in October 7, 2024
Added no_wrap option to print()
Added Columns class
Implemented pretty printing, and removed pprintpp from dependencies
The invalid `Range` suffix length `-0` is no longer accepted. #3255
Corrected docs for RichHandler which erroneously said default console writes to stderr
Reverted a fix for https://github.com/willmcgugan/rich/issues/1530
